_meta.note: Community guides — each renders at /guides/<slug> from guides/view.html. Members are matched live from the directory by category (exact) and keyword (substring against name/category/keywords/tagline). Each guide has a featured-placement slot 'guide:<slug>' managed in Admin → Sponsorships. Optional (Oct 2026): `sections` [{id,title,blurb,members:[slug],categories}] render curated groups that also auto-add members in `categories`; `ask` adds a scoped Ask Wendy box; `deals` shows member offers from businesses in the guide; `related` lists sibling guide slugs. Optional `image`: a 1200x630 cover under /images/guides/, made in Canva; used for link previews and guide cards. Nov 2026: occasion guides (plan an event, family fun, company parties, where to stay) are built from sections whose `categories` fill them from the directory; /explore.html searches every guide. Optional `referral` {occasion, need} shows a "Request a referral" card linking /referral.html with those boxes ticked.

guides.title: Senior Living & Resources
guides.lede: Trusted senior care, living communities, and support services across the West Valley.
guides.intro: The West Valley is one of Los Angeles' most senior-friendly communities — home to nationally recognized retirement communities, in-home care agencies, and advocacy organizations. Every provider listed here is a Chamber member business, accountable to our community.
guides.lede_es: Cuidado de mayores, comunidades de vida asistida y servicios de apoyo de confianza en todo el West Valley.
guides.intro_es: El West Valley es una de las comunidades más amigables para los adultos mayores de Los Ángeles — hogar de comunidades de retiro reconocidas, agencias de cuidado en casa y organizaciones de defensa. Cada proveedor aquí es un negocio miembro de la Cámara, responsable ante nuestra comunidad.
